result.title: GraphEvoResearcher: Graph-Aware Training-Free Self-Reflective Reasoning for Cost-Bounded Multi-Hop Question Answering
result.summary: Multi-hop question answering (QA) requires models to chain intermediate conclusions while remaining cost-aware. Existing training-free self-reflective protocols (generate -> critique -> revise) improve accuracy but operate on a flat token stream: revisions cannot identify which prior step is unreliable, and early stopping cannot exploit structural convergence. We introduce GraphEvoResearcher, a training-free protocol that lifts EvoResearcher's self-reflective meta-reward onto an explicit reasoning graph - nodes are intermediate conclusions/evidence and edges encode support, contradict, and depends_on. A graph-aware meta-reward combines correctness, efficiency, reflection, diversity, and four structural signals (connectivity, acyclicity, branch coverage, path convergence) to decide whether to revise, backtrack, or stop. A graph-convergence early-stop terminates when evidence branches converge on a single conclusion. On a real LLM (DeepSeek), over GSM8K, MATH, and BBH (n=50 each), GraphEvoResearcher reaches 98%, 92%, and 82% respectively, the highest of all baselines, with the largest gains on the hardest set (MATH: +24 pp over single-shot, +12 pp over flat reflection), while keeping construction cost bounded at ~2 steps / 4.5-5 nodes. Our results indicate the structural signal of a reasoning graph is most valuable exactly where single-step reasoning is unreliable.

AI.brief_summary: 提出免训练的多跳问答自反思协议 GraphEvoResearcher，把生成—批评—修订过程显式组织为推理图，用含正确性、效率、反思、多样性及连通性、无环性、分支覆盖、路径收敛四种结构信号的图感知元奖励，决定修订、回溯或停止，并以证据分支收敛作为早停条件。
AI.relevance_reason: 工作限于纯文本 LLM 推理、不涉及视觉状态，但其显式图结构推理状态、结构化信号驱动的回溯与收敛式早停，可能为 LVR 中 STOP 决策、证据分支筛选与状态表示设计提供可核查线索。
